clauses.clause: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may have target creature get +2/+0 until end of turn.
clauses.evidence: Trigger [0] fires at seat 0's beginning of combat ([this creature attacks alone, unblocked], [... opp_giant blocks it], [another creature you control (you_bear) attacks]: you_bear is targeted) and not on the opponent's turn ([on the opponent's turn, opp_bear attacks you] -> none). The +2/+0 itself never shows: combat stimuli run under the runner's combat answerer, which declines an unprimed may (run_scenarios.py _combat: may -> skip), so you_bear deals 2. Pack battle_rattle_shaman_1: may taken on seat 0's 2/2, it attacks for 4 (20 -> 16) and is 2/2 after the turn ends; battle_rattle_shaman_2: any creature, the opponent's 3/3 becomes 5/3 (toughness unchanged).
